title: Report the version with adj version
lead: `adj` cannot say which version it is.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: A release needs a version the binary reports (C165, C169).

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/cli/version.go` (new): `adj version` and `adj --version`.
- `internal/cli/cli.go`: dispatch and the usage text.
- `README.md`: how to build with the version set (`-ldflags -X`).
- `internal/cli/version_test.go`.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- `TestVersionLdflags`: with the override variable set (in the test), `adj version` and `adj --version` print it and exit 0.
- `TestVersionBuildInfo`: with no override, the output comes from runtime/debug.ReadBuildInfo through a seam the test can replace: a module version prints as is, and `(devel)` prints with the VCS revision when the build info has one.
- `TestVersionArgs`: extra arguments are a usage error.
- The round-trip test builds with `-ldflags -X ...=v0.0.0-test` and checks `adj --version`.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: - Standard library only (C169). One output line, so scripts can read it.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: - `. scripts/env.sh && go test ./... && go vet ./... && test -z "$(gofmt -l cmd internal)"` passes.
